why: ChatGPT calls the power station plug-and-play (battery, inverter, charger and outlets in one box) and recommends an inverter only to shoppers who 'already have a 12V, 24V, or 48V battery system', so neither path asks the shopper to add a second item. The inverter's voltage must match the battery the shopper already owns, and the catalog's only inverters are 48 V split-phase home units, so the page should compare power stations by watt-hours and watts and recommend one, noting that existing-battery owners need an inverter matched to that voltage.
